The quarry owner offered the company a 5-hectare plot beside the quarry at a subsidised rent of $30,000 a year, 25% below the current site rent. However, the quarry plot is 60 km from the main motorway, and wages there would be $1,700 a month compared with $2,100 at the current site. The board must decide whether to relocate the kiln beside the quarry or remain at the current site.
